headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6.1 Terra with claimed computer-use gains and lower API prices
summary: OpenAI announced GPT-6.1 Terra on Oct 26 as a model for visual reasoning and computer use, with access through ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API. OpenAI reports a 15-point gain over GPT-5.6 Terra on Agents’ Last Exam at medium effort and about one-third the cost, and a 50.3% Terminal-Bench 4.0 solve rate at maximum effort versus the previously published 21.5% for GPT-5.6 Terra. It also reports lower error rates on an internal factuality benchmark. Standard API prices are listed at $1/M input, $0.05/M cached input and $5/M output tokens. Performance and factuality figures are first-party claims; this activation did not independently reproduce them or establish matched external cost outcomes.
